name: Reborn Public Beta 1
body: First ever official release of Sky Co-op Reborn, for The Long Dark versions 2.59.

name: LTS Release 13.2
body:
- Now animals react when you drop meat/fish as decoy. Similar to vanila.
- Now wolfs will start eating deers that they killed. Visually and practically. They will eat until meat is gone or being interrupted by weather or player. Almost similar to vanilla.
- Fixed visual bugs that made some books to display incorrect skill type.
- Fixed bug when event-trigger animations like struggle or some other did not synced correctly because of bogus check of re-target ownership of animal.

name: LTS Release 13.1
body:
- Fixed bug that made all the books not readable.
- Added new book First Aid Book.
- Now animal spawners has chance to ignore spawn event and temporarily disabled this point for spawning. This should help with situations when some players experienced abnormal amout of animals. This is experimental change, please share your experience about amout of animals you find.
- Removed Herobrine.

name: LTS Release 13.0
body:
- Fixed problem related to sending large data about containers, that could lead to incorrect interpretation of received data on client side. (Saying otherwise, some bizarre rare containers content lose suppose to be fixed now).
- Deleted random floating white arms on zero coordinates on each scene.
- Added new skill book, trying to find it.
- Added Herobrine.

name: LTS Release 12.2
body:
- Fixed problem when MAC address wouldn't be able to be detected if loopback adapters was present. 

Thanks Kibbles The Rexouium for letting us know.

name: LTS Release 12.1
body:
- Now Pre-spawned ravaged deer corpses can be harvested (requires new save to be created to take effect, previously created saves will miss ravaged corpses).
- Now Handmade Lead Key finally available for crafting. Works same way as handmade key from metal scrap, but has chance to be broken on any use, read change log below to find how to make one.
- Added two variants of heat packs, one you get when you spawn, and other can be found in expeditions rewards.
- Added camping ration. New food type that you start game with.
- Added liquid lead. Can be created on campfire, stoves and etc. Requires lead scrap and recycle can.
- Added wooden form for key. Can be created by harvesting Fir or Cedar Firewood with any knife.
- Added Lead Key Template. Can be created with casting liquid lead to wooden form.
- Added Rough Lead Key. Can be taken once, Lead Key Template cools.
- Added Handmade Lead Key. Can be created by physically place Rough Lead Key on Workbench and using sharping stone on it.
- Added Present that you can open to get various gears. This presents you can find on public server during festive period.
- Fixed some issues with expeditions saving data.
- Removed Herobrine.

Thanks a lot to Jodie https://github.com/Jods-Its for creating Heat Packs models and textures.

name: LTS Release 12.0
body:
- Improved performance of downloading and uploading data about containers.
- Fixed bug when connecting to server with specified port, would override default port setting.
- Fixed various problems of hash calculation on servers that hosted on linux.
- Fixed bug when placed lanter sometimes incorrectly displayed "No fuel left" text.
- Fixed bug with loading photos.
- Added Expeditions Starter Guide that displays when you first time opening Expeditions Menu, or you can read it again by pressing Reload button when you holding Handheld Radio.
- Added hint how to display Expedition Objective panel when it forced displayed.
- Now Expedition Objective panel forced become visible for few seconds when expedition objective status update.
- Now when you pickup note that is objective related to expedition, it automatically opens reading UI.
- Now you can use domain instead of ip to connect to servers.
- Now before client trying to connect to the server, client send ping message via query protocol to test if client able to reach the server, this should help you to cancle connection if something wrong.
- Now you can see how much time has passed since someone drop gear, just look at gear and hold shift.
- Now backpacks that left after player died display how much time passed since death.
- Updated visual design of crash site, now you can way better spot smoke also added various fire flames around site.

name: LTS Release 11.6
body:
- Added new skill First Aid.
- Added console command `skip` (host only) to skip time cycle hours. Example `skip 12` will skip 12 hours of global time.
- Added console command `rpc` (host only) to execute console command on other client perspective. Example `rpc "2 set_condition 50"` will set health of client with ID 2 to 50%, and etc.
- - Added console command `skill_firstaid` (anyone if cheats enabled) to set First Aid Skill level. Example `skill_firstaid 3` to get level 3 of this skill. 
- Added time-out that cancle most of "Please wait..." actions if host did not got message from client after few seconds.
- Added some integrations for server query protocol. More about it here: `https://github.com/Filigrani/SkyCoop/wiki/Server-Query-Protocol`
- Now treating other player's affliction provides regeneration based on First Aid skill of the healer.
- Now after your death you can read books that you have read before.
- Rebalanced post treating regeneration effect to make it more valuable.

name: LTS Release 11.5
body:
- Fixed bug when in some cases players that isn't properly connected was able sent disconnect message, that was appear as nameless " disconnected!" message to the chat and webhook.
- Fixed bug when end of the day stats message displayed stats of the newly started day (that obviously was empty), rather than previous day as it should be.
- Fixed bug when some custom gears, like charcoal notes, metal blanks and other locksmithing gears wasn't possible to get because update was shipped wrong header of the .modcomponent zip file.
- Fixed critical bug when looted containers wasn't properly sent to client.
- Now you can see hunger and thirst of player when you examine them.

name: LTS Release 11.4
body:
Include (Content of v1.13 pre-release)

- Fixed bug when holding any melee weapon or hand held radio, HUD displayed ammo type text of previous valid equippable gear.
- Fixed bug when on integrated server, host had false statistic about play time.
- Fixed bug when human corpse containers was always marked as "Empty" even if have gears from other players.
- Added controls text prompt hint when you equipping handheld radio.
- Added !stats and !today chat commands that shows your statistic, and server's today statistic.
- Added !cfg chat command that shows current server's configurations settings.
- Added random crash site expeditions. (Exclusive for Public server).
- Now cattail, rosehips, old man's beard, mushrooms, respawn 3 days after being harvested.
- Now you can't takes ropes that has been already deployed, to avoid players being stuck in places where ropes is only one exit point.
- Now charcoal note has unice model.
- Now you can hold charcoal note in hands.
- Now rock caches are syncable.

Additional fixes

- Fixed bug when in some cases you wasn't able to throw stones and it lead to softlock.
- Now progress of active crash sites saves among sessions.
- Now crash site cooldown saves among sessions.

name: LTS Release 11.2
body:
- Fully reworked saving and sync method of picked gears to improve performance and speedup saving and loading time.
- Fully reworked saving and sync method of looted containers to improve performance and speedup saving and loading time.
- Fixed bug when on dedicated server flairs wasn't visible on players model.
- Fixed bug when random chances of cattails and other harvestables wasn't synced.
- Fixed micro freeze when someone harvested something on same scene where you are.
- Fixed critical bug when some affliction wasn't curable because of new weather sync.
- Fixed bug when host was able to accept broken data about container, now if client provides invalid data about container host will reject this data and will ask client to attempt to send data once again.
- Fixed softlock if host somehow manage to send broken data about container, now if client gets invalid data, they can attempt to request data once again or cancle opening this container.
- Fixed bug when confirm button in "YOU GOT NEW FLAIRS" dialog did nothing.
- Fixed problem mods validation compiled wrong main hash of your mods, because of incorrect sorting method, so now everyone who wasn't able to join our dedicated server even with having correct set of mods, should not experience any problems.
- Fixed chat text offset to avoid cropping.
- Now if container has anything that any players put inside, will display "(Searched)" instead of "(Empty)".
- Added more emotion for self-expression.
- Changed how chance of success lockpicking calculated.

name: LTS Release 11.1
body:
- Fixed bug when lantern did not update state of light when fuel is over.
- Fixed fatal black screens softlock when client loaded interior for first time.

name: LTS Release 11.0
body:
- Fully reworked weather sync, now host does not affect natural behavior of weather stages and weather transitions.
- Dedicated server written from scratch, now it works as seperated app.
- Fixed problem when weather style was not same across other players perspective (For example different fog density or different light scheme), now all players can observe identical weather.
- Fixed problem when host sent data to client that isn't completely joined, that lead to client softlock on connection.
- Minor optimization of client side.
- Improved retry package send system. Now there more packages that client can send another request, if host by some reason does not reply on awaiting request.
- Cabin fever is disabled now.
- Intestinal parasites now replaced with longer food poison that starts with initial damage and drainage of your stats that depends of how much tainted food you ate.
- Now in main menu doesn't have single player options.
- Now players on different regions can have different weather sets, this means, weather now using correct settings for each region, and does not mimic setting of region where host is.
- Now weather time and transitions correctly progressing when everyone on server is sleeping.
- Now other players can't damage you when you loading scene data.
- Now you can lock buildings with keys by right clicking on the door from outside.
- Now you can lockpick locked buildings.
- Now you can knock to the locked door.
- Now you can let other players enter locked door without key, if they knocking to the door, right click on the door from inside, and click on the name of player.
- Now you can forge metal blanks for locksmithing.
- Now you can place metal scap or metal blank to start locksmithing.
- Now you can use charcoal for writing custom notes.
- Now you can use hacksaw and sharping stone for locksmithing.
- Now you can create metal small blank by sawing metal blank via locksmithing.
- Now you can create rough handmade key by sawing small metal blank via locksmithing.
- Now you can create handmade key by sharping rough handmade key via locksmithing.
- Now you can send messages to local area text chat, if you want to send message to the global chat, you need to hold handhald radio in hands.
- Now when you quit game, it attempt to auto-save.
- Added handmade key.
- Added rough handmade key.
- Added small metal blank.
- Added metal blank.
- Added lockpick.

Dedicated server changes:

- Added optional save scam protection, if enabled, players will not be able to join server if last used save file on this server is different from current one  that player attempt to load.
- Added optional mods validation system, if enabled, only players that has identical mods will be able to join. This means, if an mod is missing or player has any extra mods, they will be kicked.
- Added option that disables PVP on the server.
- Added safe zones, where PVP is disabled.

name: Release 10.4
body:
- Fixed faital crash when some users wasn't able to run game correctly, because plugins check has been passed when it should not. Now plugins validation checks for every needed plugin, and deletes old ones, if they exist, to avoid crash of failed attempt to replace already existing ones files. You may get this bug if you has older version of the mod, that was shipped with audio plugin but with no autoupdating plugin, and after manual installation get this problem. (If you have this problem, delete "Plugins" folder completely and let mod to recover it, or update manually, if mod works okay, just ignore this).
- Added more flairs for customization, check Multiplayer->Settings->Customization.

name: Release 10.3
body:
HOT FIX

- Fixed critical bug with loading of flairs data.

name: Release 10.2
body:
- Fixed bug when melee weapons was possible to use even if other action in the progress.
- Fixed bug when some picked items was invisible in examine screen on interloper difficulty.
- Change algorithm of opening doors that require input of code on keypad, in vanila game player was suppose to get code once they touch "key item", but if you die or get paper with code from someone else this won't add code for you. So now in mod, once you interact with keypad, it scans all your papers, and if you have that one with correct code it opens the door. This solves all problems when player avoided code getting trigger. As additional feature, now if you get "key item" via console it will works for opening the door aswell. 
- Now all collectible items are duppable (can be picked by every player) automatically, even if they does not required for progression.

name: Release 10.1
body:
- Fixed problem when users that had version 9.9 wasn't able to update to 9.9b, because updating plugin can't validate version if it has non number symbols. We took it for granted. Now even minor patches will not contain letters in the version naming in order to avoid such a problem in the future.
- Fixed problem when custom nickname wasn't able to load when game started, because path to persistent files wasn't initialized yet.

name: Release 9.9b
body:
- Now arrows inserted to the animals do not disappear when animal retarget to another player, and now arrows drops around the corpse upon death of  animal.
- Fixed bug when some elements of menu is not hidden after entering host menu if user has not server settings saves.
- Added SETTINGS menu to the MULTIPLAYER sub-menu, where you can change your multiplayer nickname, so nickname.txt useless you can delete this now.

name: Releases 9.9
body:
- Now Jeremiah Knife can be taked in hands.
- Now players maximum, ports and other server settings are saved once you host server, so now you not need configure options every start of the server
- Fixed problem when mod has been counted as out of date on every launch because of some files did not had correct version label.

name: Releases 9.8c
body:
- Experimental update that adds the ability to auto-update through the plugin from ds5678, and start-up code that installs audio addon and auto update plugin itself it they are missing.
- Now dependencies that mod use no more ships with Sky Co-Op, but will be downloaded by auto-updater, to not worry user about downloading it manually and having a lot of files from other modders.
- Fixed problem when wasn't possible to change server config in next sessions.

name: Releases 9.8
body:
- Now animals teleports to random point after spawn, so won't be looks so obvious that they in same place even after tone hours indoor.
- Now after animal killed, it won't respawn instantly after re-visiting area after being indoor, but can be spawned again 1-2 days.
- Experimental EGS and GOG functions.

name: Release 9.7c
body:
- Now host knows which clients are currently loading scene and gives them more time before time-out starts.
- Improved repeat request manager to more properly ask host for another request if previous wasn't delivered in emergency situations.
- Fixed problem when some users encounted with problem they lost connectioon after loading scene on client side.

name: Release 9.7
body:
- Fixed problem when sleeping player position may look incorrect.
- Fixed problem when bedrolls and beds from other mods was works incorrect.
- Now when you refuse from taking gear that you found in container that gear will be dropped on floor.

(Pre-release changes that included in this release build)
- Completely reworked saving of dropped and stored gears in containers.
- Should be fixed all situations when you was able to lose saved gears.
- Returned system for checking saves for compatibility when hosting server.
- Fixed UI softlock when you try to enter to multiplayer menu without any saved games in survival mode.
- Fixed bug when unique icon when you talk to the radio.
- Fixed bug when you was able to talk to voice chat when typing to text chat or console.
- Fixed bug when handheld radio did not had icon in radial menu, now it looks correctly in navigation tab of radial menu.
- Fixed minor error logs.
- Now your radio frequency shown above radio speaking indicator.
- Now your radio frequency saves after restarting game.
- Now when you start new game, you get random radio frequency set by default.
- Now handheld radio has much more channels.
- Now Mackenzie has own speech lines when examine other player's afflictions. Astrid still use ones from episode 3, but Mackenzie has own phrases that more context related.
- Added speech lines on the beginning of examine other players.
- Removed command !dupesboxes for a while, until I test out it on new drop sync build.
- Reworked death code.
- Now on death player drops named backpack with all gears and collectable items.
- Now you can't have more than one technical backpacks.
- Now you can respawn after death.
- Now after respawn you lose all skills you had.
- Now if you die from drowning in water by falling through ice your loot will be on nearest safe spot.
- Now dropped and stored gears saved in steam cloud.

name: Release 9.5
body:
- Now new saves by default named with data of creation.
- Fixed various problems with fixed spawn and same as host spawn options.
- Fixed incorrect text about spawn region in the lobby, when you select Random or Client's choice spawn style.
- Fixed problem of selecting Random region would result to empty string in vote menu.
- Fixed problem when in Random spawn style, host was able to select start region for clients.
- Added icon of selected experience mode in the lobby.
- Added unique icon when you talk to the radio.
- Experemental fix for animals.

name: Release 9.4
body:
- Completly reworked and improved voice chat for steam version of the game.
- Completly reworked ui. Now you can join and create server right from the main menu. Now you not need to load save before you will be able to host the server. Also players of steam version of the game now can create lobby, where they can wait for other players and vote for experience mode and starting location.
- Added handheld radio. Now you can talk with other players even on the distance. Set Up radio frequency and talk privately. With immersive radio noise filter. Also you can't talk and lissen in same time like a with real radio. You always have handheld radion in your starting gears.
- Added browser of public servers. Now steam version players in one click can host public server, and other players easily can join with ingame server browser.
- Experiemental melee weapons. You can equip in hands knifies, prybars, hatchet and other. Use already known gears in completly frash way! You can scare away animals with this, or attack animals that in struggle with your teammate. Also be careful you can hurt your teammates with it too.
- Now you can wear cooking pot on your head, this won't warm you, but can protect your head from bullets. Put this on, if you not trust your friend's accuracy.
- Now equipment on the model of other players is interactable. For example you can borrow rifle from the back of other player and take it right in your hands.
- Now placed lit lantern now syncs. When it placed, it burn in real time timeline, so abuse it if you want.
- Now skill books now stores reading progress separated for each player, this means now one book can be read by multiple players.
- Fixed problem when client pickedup dry pelts or other various evolving items but it end up fresh again.
- Fixed possible problem with sleeping time skips.
